reference_sql:
WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event from 1 to 7 December 2025
  SELECT event_date, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS session_engaged
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
)
SELECT event_date,
  COUNT(DISTINCT user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(ga_session_id AS VARCHAR)) AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN session_engaged = '1' THEN user_pseudo_id || '-' || CAST(ga_session_id AS VARCHAR) END) AS engaged_sessions
FROM starts
GROUP BY event_date
alternatives:
WITH starts AS (
  -- one row per session_start event with both IDs from 1 to 7 December 2025
  SELECT event_date,
    [p.value.string_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'session_engaged'][1] AS session_engaged
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
    AND user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL
    AND [p.value.int_value FOR p IN event_params IF p.key = 'ga_session_id'][1] IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT event_date, COUNT(*) AS sessions, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE session_engaged = '1') AS engaged_sessions
FROM starts
GROUP BY event_date

WITH sessions AS (
  -- one row per session (user_pseudo_id and ga_session_id) that started from 1 to 7 December 2025
  SELECT DISTINCT event_date, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS ga_session_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS session_engaged
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start'
    AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
)
SELECT event_date, COUNT(*) AS sessions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN session_engaged = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged_sessions
FROM sessions
WHERE user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND ga_session_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY event_date

solver.query:
WITH s AS (
  SELECT event_date, user_pseudo_id,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'ga_session_id')[1].value.int_value AS sid,
    list_filter(event_params, lambda p: p.key = 'session_engaged')[1].value.string_value AS eng
  FROM events
  WHERE event_name = 'session_start' AND event_date BETWEEN '20251201' AND '20251207'
)
SELECT event_date, COUNT(DISTINCT (user_pseudo_id, sid)) AS sessions,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN eng = '1' THEN (user_pseudo_id, sid) END) AS engaged_sessions
FROM s WHERE user_pseudo_id IS NOT NULL AND sid IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY event_date
